name: Kazami
source:
Side character of episode 2
One of the members from the vigilante selected by [url=/c92659]Nishima[/url] to assist [url=/c92637]Rei[/url] and [url=/c92638]Aruru[/url] in their mountain exploration trip.
A handsome man doted on by many women.
Kazami is good at handling firearms. He acquires knowledge not through official military training, but rather by self-studying.
